name: Threads
description: Slate thread/episode architecture for long-horizon agentic tasks. Implements thread weaving: bounded worker episodes synchronized back into one orchestration thread, solving context rot without losing information at subagent boundaries.

maxStepsPerEpisode.description: Maximum tool-call steps a thread worker may take per dispatch (default: 30)

defaultProvider.description: Provider for thread worker runs (falls back to agent default)

defaultModel.description: Model for thread worker runs (falls back to agent default)

sessionTtlMs.description: How long (ms) to keep thread session state in memory (default: 3600000 = 1h)
